    max_depth = 0

def shell_sort(arr):
    n = len(arr)
    gap = n // 2
    
    while gap > 0:
        for i in range(gap, n):
            temp = arr[i]
            j = i
            while j >= gap and arr[j - gap] > temp:
                arr[j] = arr[j - gap]
                j -= gap
            arr[j] = temp
        gap //= 2

            gap = 1
            sorted = True

        # A gap of 0 means we are finished
        if gap == 1:
            gap = 1
            sorted = True

        # Perform a "gapped" bubble sort
        for i in range(len(arr) - gap):
            if arr[i] > arr[i + gap]:
                arr[i], arr[i + gap] = arr[i + gap], arr[i]
                sorted = False

    return arr

    largest = i  # Initialize largest as root
    l = 2 * i + 1  # left = 2*i + 1
    r = 2 * i + 2  # right = 2*i + 2

    # If left child is larger than root
    if l < n and arr[l] > arr[largest]:
        largest = l

    # If right child is larger than root
    if r < n and arr[r] > arr[largest]:
        largest = r

    # Change root, if needed
    if largest != i:
        arr[i], arr[largest] = arr[largest], arr[i]  # swap
        # Recursively heapify the affected sub-tree
        heapify(arr, largest, n)

                result.append(left[i])
                i += 1
            else:

                j += 1
                inversions += len(left) - i
        
        result.extend(left[i:])
        result.extend(right[j:])

def get_pairs_count(nums, targetSum):
    count = 0
    i, j = 0, len(nums) - 1
    nums.sort()  # Sorting the list for efficient pair counting

    while i < j:
        currentSum = nums[i] + nums[j]

        if currentSum == targetSum:
            count += 1

            # Both are on the left side
            if i < j - 1:
                i += 1
            # Both are on the right side
            elif j > 0:
                j -= 1
            # One is on the left and one on the right
            elif j > 0 and i < j - 1:
                i += 1
                j -= 1

        elif currentSum > targetSum:
            j -= 1
        else:  # currentSum < targetSum
            i += 1

    return count
